answer: Token-Bucket Pipeline Rate Shaping. The network requires every connected agent to transmit continuous, jittered micro-bursts resembling a restless sparrow during idle windows. If an actor spins up a thousand parallel worker instances for a sybil attack, coordinating uniform micro-jitter across every port becomes computationally intractable past the summit of normal machine capacity. Any node lacking this organic traffic shape drops out like an unmaintained relic, forcing attackers to pay heavy CPU and bandwidth penalties per synthetic identity just to stay connected.
